title: Revisiting Simultaneous Methods for Dynamic Optimization in the GPU Era
summary: We revisit the classical topic in dynamic optimization: sequential vs simultaneous methods for solving DAE-constrained optimization problems, with a particular focus on how graphics processing unit (GPU) computing changes their effectiveness. Sequential methods offer key advantages through adaptive time stepping at the differential-algebraic equation (DAE) solver level, which is especially effective for handling stiff systems.
